import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { customers } from "../../../backend/schema/customers";

export const customersCms = customizeTable<typeof customers>("customers", {
    icon: "Users",
    display: {
        title: "companyName"
    },
    listFields: ["customerId", "companyName", "contactName", "contactTitle", "phone", "address"],
    fieldOrder: [
        "customerId",
        "companyName",
        "contactName",
        "contactTitle",
        "phone",
        "address",
        "city",
        "region",
        "postalCode",
        "country",
        "fax"
    ]
});
